messages:
Sam (DevRel): Quick idea 10: run a 30m mini-lab for community contributors that walks through a tiny OSS refapp + short benchmark. Focus: low-friction starter that shows cost vs latency tradeoffs.
Priya (Content): Love it. I can write a "how-we-built" short post + 4 social cards. Tone: pragmatic + show numbers.
Noah (Bench): For narrative: show 3 configs (hosted small, hosted medium, local quant) with p50/p95 and $/1000 tokens. Simple CSV + a single chart will do.
Tess (Growth): I'll set up the RSVP and inbound routing. Flow: Google Form -> HubSpot -> Segment -> Salesforce. Want to capture role and deployment preference.
Marco (OSS): I'll prep the repo with a tiny examples/mini-lab folder and add contributor steps. Also add a CODE_OF_CONDUCT and license blurb.
Sam (DevRel): Keep the demo to a single script: clone -> env -> run. Under 5 commands. Add a "try on hosted" button for people not wanting local.
Priya (Content): Draft outline: 1) Why mini-lab (30s) 2) Setup (2m) 3) Build: 10m 4) Run bench: 5m 5) Cleanup & next steps 6) Contrib call-to-action. I'll sketch copy by Thu.
Noah (Bench): Example bench command I'll use: 
```
seq 1 50 | xargs -I{} -P8 curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello world","max_tokens":64}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Capture times with `date +%s%3N` and compute percentiles. Will attach bench.csv.
Tess (Growth): RSVP fields: name, email, org, role, expected deployment (hosted/dedicated/private), consent to follow-up. Add hidden utm_source.
Marco (OSS): Can we add a tiny badge "run in 5 mins" to README and a GitHub Actions CI that lints examples?
Sam (DevRel): Yes, and include a short video snippet (15s) that shows the demo running and the chart. Priya can narrate.
Priya (Content): I'll also prepare short copy variants for LinkedIn and a developer-focused Twitter thread. Keep one stat: "setup + run in under 5 minutes".
Noah (Bench): Quick Q: sequences to test? Suggest: prompt-only (32 tokens), medium (128 tokens), long (512 tokens). We'll run each once for 50 samples to keep cloud costs low.
Tess (Growth): Routing: HubSpot list = "mini-lab-mar-2026". If org email matches enterprise domains list -> assign to AE queue. I'll add a webhook to Segment for analytics.
Marco (OSS): I'm adding a CONTRIBUTING.md with a small "how to file an issue" template and a short local dev Dockerfile.
Sam (DevRel): Also include an optional step: enable KV prefix cache in example. Add a config toggle.
Priya (Content): Draft assets: blog (800-1000 words), 4 images (setup, code, bench chart, CTA), 4 social card captions, 30s demo clip. Will aim to publish 48h before the event.
Noah (Bench): Bench script will output CSV like: timestamp,config,latency_ms,tokens. I'll upload bench.csv to the repo under /benchouts.
Tess (Growth): Reminder: capture GDPR consent checkbox for EU attendees. Also add timezone selector in form.
release-bot: Automated note: new release branch created: refs/heads/mini-lab-2026-03 by Marco (OSS). CI checks pending.
Marco (OSS): Pushing initial commit now. Will include Dockerfile and GH Action.
Sam (DevRel): Rehearsal? 30m slot the day before. Sam + Priya + Noah + Tess. Prefer Tue 11am PT.
Priya (Content): Tue 11am PT works.
Noah (Bench): Confirming Tue 11am. I'll bring final CSVs and chart exports.
Tess (Growth): I'll set up email sequence: reminder 24h and 1h. Also a follow-up with resources + link to repo.
Sam (DevRel): Owner recap: Marco = repo & CI, Priya = content + assets, Noah = bench scripts + csvs, Tess = RSVP & routing, Sam = host + recording.
Priya (Content): Small ask: can someone grab a 15s screen capture of the setup step? I'll stitch into the social clip.
Marco (OSS): I can record it and drop mp4 in /assets.
Noah (Bench): Upload link: https://internal.redwood/benchouts/mini-lab-2026-03/bench.csv (will upload before rehearsal).
Tess (Growth): Creating HubSpot form now and will post the link here when ready.
Sam (DevRel): Great work team. Let's aim to ship the repo and assets by Friday EOD so marketing can queue emails. :rocket:
